purpose: bounded clean-base QLoRA feasibility and generalization study, not Jev parity
evaluation_rules: No proprietary Jev outputs or released Open-Jev weights are used for training.
No training, calibration, test, or OOD ID or group overlap is allowed.
OOD sources are excluded from fitting and calibration.
Overlong rows are excluded transparently; no truncation of decision state.
Train once with frozen hyperparameters, then fit temperature only on calibration.
Report baseline and trained metrics per decision kind, including regressions.
No runtime promotion or claim of untouched model-pretraining data.
